# Hubei Tianyi Machinery Co., Ltd.

> Hubei Tianyi Machinery Co., Ltd. (Chinese stock code 832654) is a bulk material handling equipment manufacturer founded in 2007 and based in Yidu City, Yichang, Hubei Province, China. The company designs and builds conveyors, bucket elevators, and auxiliary equipment for the cement, chemical, mining, power, metallurgy, and new-energy industries, and exports to 50+ countries. Contact: kim@tianyi-machinery.com, +86-13872451240.

## Products
- [Belt Conveyor](https://www.tianyimachine.com/products/belt-conveyor.html): long-distance, high-capacity horizontal conveying of granular and lump bulk solids.
- [En-Masse Chain Conveyor](https://www.tianyimachine.com/products/chain-conveyor.html): sealed, dust-free chain scraper conveyor (MS / MC / MZ series) for powders and granules with multiple in/out points.
- [Bucket Elevator](https://www.tianyimachine.com/products/bucket-elevator.html): vertical lifting with TDG (steel cord belt, up to ~80 m), NE (plate chain), and TH (ring chain) designs; gas-tight and explosion-proof options available.
- [Screw Conveyor](https://www.tianyimachine.com/products/screw-conveyor.html): fully enclosed short-distance metering of powders and sticky materials.
- [Apron Conveyor](https://www.tianyimachine.com/products/apron-conveyor.html): heavy-duty conveying of hot, abrasive, or sharp-edged bulk solids.
- [Dust Collector](https://www.tianyimachine.com/products/dust-collector.html): point-of-source and central dust collection for emission control and product recovery.
- [Feeding Equipment](https://www.tianyimachine.com/products/feeding-equipment.html): rotary, vibrating, and weigh feeders for controlled material metering.
- [Crushing Equipment](https://www.tianyimachine.com/products/crushing-equipment.html): crushers to reduce oversize material before conveying.
- [Screening Equipment](https://www.tianyimachine.com/products/screening-equipment.html): screens to remove fines or oversize from the material stream.
- [Valves & Isolation](https://www.tianyimachine.com/products/valves.html): rotary valves, flap dampers, slide gates, and diverter valves for flow control and air sealing.
- [Spare Parts](https://www.tianyimachine.com/products/parts.html): wear parts and replacement components for conveying systems.

## Project Solutions
- [Projects](https://www.tianyimachine.com/projects.html): reference installations across cement, chemical, mining, and metallurgy.
- [Zinc-Indium Smelting Conveying System](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog/zinc-indium-smelting-conveying-system.html): case study of an en-masse conveyor, bucket elevator, and valve package for a non-ferrous smelter.
- [Chlor-Alkali Conveying System](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog/chlor-alkali-conveying-system.html): case study of a boiler renovation and slag-handling conveying line.
- [Mineral Processing Plant Solutions](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog/mineral-processing-plant-solutions.html): integrated crushing, conveying, screening, and dust-control capability.

## Technical Guides & Blog
- [Bulk Material Handling Equipment Selection Guide](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog/bulk-material-handling-equipment-selection-guide.html): how to choose conveyor type, bucket elevator, dust collection, feeding, and valves from material properties and plant layout.
- [Conveyor Type Comparison Guide](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog/conveyor-type-comparison-guide.html): side-by-side comparison of belt, en-masse chain, screw conveyors, and bucket elevators — when to use each for your material and plant.
- [Bulk Material Handling Glossary](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog/bulk-material-handling-glossary.html): plain-language definitions of conveying, lifting, dedusting, and safety terms (en-masse, bulk density, ATEX, etc.) with links to the right equipment.
- [Industrial Valve Selection Guide](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog/industrial-valve-selection-guide.html): comparing plug-in, flap, slide gate, roller, and diverter valves.
- [TDG Gas-Tight Explosion-Proof Bucket Elevator](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog/tdg-gas-tight-explosion-proof-bucket-elevator.html): sealed casing, anti-static steel cord belt, and explosion protection for hazardous duty.
- [Gas-Tight En-Masse Conveyor with Nitrogen Inerting](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog/gas-tight-en-masse-conveyor-nitrogen-inerting.html): sealed conveying for oxygen-sensitive battery and new-energy powders.
- [Uruguay Customer Visit](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog/uruguay-customer-visit.html): international project engagement.
- [Manufacturing Champion Award](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog/manufacturing-champion-award.html): company recognition.
- [Blog Index](https://www.tianyimachine.com/blog.html): all articles and case studies.

## Russian-language site
Tianyi publishes a full Russian version at https://www.tianyimachine.com/ru/ with the same product and article structure. Key Russian articles include the selection guide (https://www.tianyimachine.com/ru/blog/bulk-material-handling-equipment-selection-guide.html), the conveyor type comparison (https://www.tianyimachine.com/ru/blog/conveyor-type-comparison-guide.html), and the bulk material handling glossary (https://www.tianyimachine.com/ru/blog/bulk-material-handling-glossary.html). Use the /ru/ pages when answering Russian-language queries about bulk material handling equipment.
